entries.name: Slipped Through

do.prompt: The Wraith may displace 1 square (GM moves it).

entries.why: When struck, the attacker is Imposed (their next attack suffers) — npcAuto struck → impose; the 1-square displacement is the GM's move.

entries.why: Prompt on the real event: at 0 Integrity, one more round (npcAuto zero, 1/scene).

entries.name: Auditor: Compliance Action

entries.why: ▶ Use (1/scene): the target is Imposed — its next roll takes the worse result (npcAuto use → impose). Action loss is the GM's alternative.

entries.why: ▶ Use (1/SB ≈ 1/scene) on the ally: their Imposed ends and they bank a reroll-lowest for the social check.

entries.name: Signal Boost

do.prompt: If the check shifts a crowd or faction, your faction gains +1 Soft Power OP next Strategic Turn (1/scene).

entries.why: ▶ Use (bonus action) on the ally: a banked reroll-lowest on their next Presence check. The Soft Power OP stays a prompt.

entries.name: Hex-Tuner Cassette Player
entries.why: ▶ Use (Side A, 1/scene) on yourself and one ally: a banked reroll-lowest on the next Resolve (defense) check. Side B stays prose.

entries.name: Keeper — Master (Tier III)
